# Swap Tron — Swap Tokens on TRON Reference

> Trade TRX, USDT and TRC-20 tokens on the TRON network through a non-custodial decentralized exchange. Resources paid in TRX. Independent, not affiliated with TRON.

## Key Facts
- TRON: layer-1 blockchain; native coin TRX; tokens follow the TRC-20 standard
- USDT on TRON (TRC-20) is among the most widely used stablecoin transfers
- Swaps route through on-chain DEXs (SunSwap-style); uses TRON wallets like TronLink
- Fees: TRON meters transactions with bandwidth and energy, paid by burning TRX or staking TRX
- Also: DEX pool fee + price impact; a TRC-20 interaction can need a one-time approval
- Custody: non-custodial — wallet signs; settlement through on-chain smart contracts
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by the TRON Foundation
